name: 05-stage-clear
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. Reference1 UI brand, reference2 Xiaocui goal pose exact identity, reference3 finish gate. Create a single LEVEL CLEAR results screen. Bright sky-white city finish area softly simplified in background. Left 42%: full-body Xiaocui running while raising V fingers joyfully, preserve reference hair/clothes/shoes, checkered finish gate behind her, no balls. Right-center 48%: beautiful white rounded route-sign results panel, top orange/blue heading '過關！', below '1-1 白色大道'. Exactly THREE large gold stars in a row. Clean aligned results rows '分數' '0042600' and '金幣' '68 / 80'. Three compact checked achievement lines: '完成關卡', '金幣達 70%', '全程無傷'. Bottom main large orange button '下一關' arrow, below two quiet white/blue buttons '再跑一次' and '關卡地圖'. All Traditional Chinese legible, generous padding, strong hierarchy. Short arcs and finish-line cues only at panel corners, minimal celebratory dots. No invented currency balance, loot boxes, daily rewards, rank medals or three-place podium. Screenshot fills16:9. A joyful confident end to a run, coherent with title and HUD.
